entries.86a8aef22fe88f82: This business forms and manages funds, mainly for investment in unlisted companies. As GP, it handles everything from forming and selecting deals to post-investment management support and achieving Exit, earns capital gains and carried interest, and also invests its own funds in the funds as an LP investor. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥8,180 million, an increase of 427.7% from the previous year. This was because shares held by Dolphin No. 1 Investment Limited Partnership were sold and dividends were received.
